description: This Java source file defines the QueueHelper utility class used for managing media playback queues, including functions to generate queues based on media IDs, search queries, or genres, as well as utilities for queue item indexing.

classes.name: QueueHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for constructing and managing media playback queues, including converting media metadata to queue items, fetching queues by media category or search, and queue manipulations.

methods.name: getPlayingQueue
methods.description: Constructs a playback queue based on a media ID by extracting hierarchy and fetching tracks from MusicProvider according to category type; supports genre and search categories.

methods.name: getPlayingQueueFromSearch
methods.description: Creates a playback queue from a search query using MusicProvider's searchMusic method.

methods.name: getMusicIndexOnQueue
methods.description: Finds the index of a media item in the queue by matching media ID.

methods.name: getMusicIndexOnQueue
methods.description: Finds the index of a media item in the queue by matching queue ID.

methods.name: convertToQueue
methods.description: Converts an iterable of MediaMetadata tracks into a list of QueueItems, embedding hierarchy-aware media IDs.

methods.name: getRandomQueue
methods.description: Generates a queue using the first genre from MusicProvider, or returns an empty list if none available.

methods.name: isIndexPlayable
methods.description: Checks if a given index is within valid range for the current queue.
